mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as svvContractorName, c1.C_Abbreviation as svvContrAbbName, svis.Svis_Project_Name as svisProjectName, svis.Svis_Name as svisName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Con_Sv_Verify mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on con.Con_Project_Id = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Svv_Contractor_Id = c1.C_Id left join Con_Svis svis on mn.Svis_Id = svis.Svis_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Svv_Id where mn.Svv_Id = #{svvId}
select count(1) from Con_Sv_Verify mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on con.Con_Project_Id=pro.P_ID ${params.authSql}
